summary: Code should ideally include tests, but live testing against real equipment is often more valuable than simulated tests, and everything should be tested manually first.
questions: Should I test a PR on real hardware?

answer_card.title: How to test a PR
answer_card.answer_md: Prefer PRs that add tests, but live testing on real equipment can beat simulated automation, especially for APIs and many platforms. Always test manually the first time.
